info.title: Andaru local engine API
info.description: Experimental root-local engine API over Unix sockets only. Verified UID 0 SO_PEERCRED authorizes every route. Network status is observed; configuration writes create durable saved versions and never activate networking. No application accounts, HTTP identity headers, cookie/token authentication, live-generation/apply or backup service is implemented. Contracts remain provisional until Andaru 1.0.

get.summary: Read the complete current host link/address snapshot
get.description: Reads Debian iproute2 in the engine's host namespace. Failure is explicit, never a partial snapshot or a stale cache. Addresses retain host bits. The bounded full snapshot is not paginated.
